metadata.scenario: A prospect wants to know about the different types of investment accounts available at the bank. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Dorothy Henderson. I’m calling about my physical therapy and personal care services. Hi Dorothy! How are you doing today? I’m doing okay, just a bit concerned about my upcoming sessions. I understand, what specific concerns do you have? Well, I’d like to ensure that I continue with morning visits and that I have female caregivers only. Absolutely, I’ll make a note of that preference for you. Thank you! Also, could you tell me about the skilled nursing services? Sure! Our skilled nursing care includes medication management, wound care, and health monitoring, priced at $95 to $125 for 1 to 2 hours. That sounds helpful. I might need that soon. Just let us know when you’re ready, and we can arrange that for you. Great! I also wanted to ask about my last physical therapy session. That was two days ago, right? How did that go? It went well, but I think I need more guidance on my exercises. I can schedule an extra session or update your care plan to focus on that. How does that sound? An extra session would be perfect! Let me check our schedule. Would you prefer a morning time again? Yes, please! How about this Thursday at 9 AM? That works for me. Great! I’ll confirm that for you. Thanks, Margaret. One last thing, can I also get updates on my medication management? Sure! Our medication management service is priced between $65 and $80 for 30 to 45 minutes. I think I need that after my surgery. I can have one of our nurses reach out to you to discuss your medication management needs. That sounds good. I’ll schedule that follow-up and confirm your extra therapy session. Thank you so much for your help, Margaret! You’re welcome, Dorothy! If you have any other questions, just give us a call. I will, thanks again! Have a great day! You too!
